name: shader-spiral-pass
title: Shader Spiral Pass
description: A neon spiral tunnel swallows the outgoing scene, the camera dives through its center, and an expanding aperture reveals the incoming scene. Rebuilt with a deterministic Canvas 2D tunnel instead of the original WebGL shader. The block draws its own colored field between two built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .ssp-panel elements); to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels and keep the block on a track above.
useWhen: A hero moment: a dive through a tunnel into the next scene.
Tech, gaming or music content that wants an energetic, glowing scene change.
avoidWhen: Videos that already use several loud transitions.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Spirals
variables.description: Number of spiral ribbons around the tunnel.

variables.label: Zoom
variables.description: Magnification reached while passing through the center.

variables.label: Softness
variables.description: Feather of the revealing aperture, as a fraction of the shorter side.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Multiplier for the tunnel’s own motion.
